captions.text: Open My certifications in Responder.
This area gives the signed-in member a place to review their
own certification records.
The training account has an existing Firefighter qualification,
marked Active, with the number DEMO-CERT-1 and an expiry date.
Open the intended record before changing it.
An organization can use this recordkeeping pattern for its own required
qualifications, including community response, search teams, security,
contractor crews, and industrial response.

captions.text: Review the record detail before acting.
Check the number, issuer, area, received date, expiry date, and verification date.

These fields help keep an education entry attached to the correct qualification.
